scope: Read-only investigation of three items carried open from the field-DCT cycle.

logic_decrease.question: Logic fell 372 ALMs and 912 registers while a feature was added.
logic_decrease.method: Analysis and Synthesis run on the pre-change source at 3e89189 and compared with the field-DCT build.
logic_decrease.resolution: No logic was pruned. Synthesis produced the fourteen registers the change calls for. The decrease is a fitter effect: register duplication for fanout and packing differed between placements.
logic_decrease.consequence: The apparent saving is not real and must not be banked; a different seed or the next feature will move it again.

hdmi_setup_margin.question: Setup slack fell 0.117 ns to +0.126 ns.
hdmi_setup_margin.resolution: Placement pressure from added logic on the one domain with almost no headroom, which is the mechanism entry 370 documented and measured at about two percent.
hdmi_setup_margin.correction: An earlier reading of general[1] Fmax at 60.7 MHz as alarming was wrong; that domain's slack is +2.043 ns. The Fmax column is restricted by other constraints and is not headroom.
hdmi_setup_margin.response: Reseed rather than restructure if a later change pushes this category negative.
hdmi_setup_margin.status: explained; margin remains the binding constraint

capture_variation.question: Screenshot variation first recorded in entry 644 and unisolated.

signature.character: Content dependent and chroma dominated; sampled pairs show red unchanged while green swings fully.

capture_variation.localisation: Readback or display path on one byte lane of each 64-bit word. Not decode and not framebuffer content: counters are identical between captures and one capture of an unchanged frame matched a released-bitstream baseline exactly.
capture_variation.playback_impact: No evidence. The user reports both fixtures play perfectly, and these are the most detailed fixtures where the deltas are largest.
capture_variation.actual_cost: Reliability of the pixel-comparison regression method. Entry 644 nearly recorded a false regression and entry 653 nearly repeated it.
capture_variation.mitigation: Capture the completed frame twice and compare the best of the two. Proven on two fixtures, costs seconds.
capture_variation.recommendation: Do not spend a development cycle on the root cause. Revisit only if visible shimmer is reported on real content, at which point it becomes a quality question rather than a measurement one.
capture_variation.status: characterised and mitigated; root cause deliberately not pursued
